items.summary: A report from the public inquiry into neonatal care at the Countess of Chester Hospital where Lucy Letby worked, chaired by senior appeal court judge Kathryn Thirlwall, shows a limited understanding of leadership and accountability in the NHS and fails to address the realities of NHS management.
